name: Fluxknight - Customer Support AI - Multi Tenant v2

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const required=['organization_id','agent_id','idempotency_key','channel','input']; const missing=required.filter(k=>b[k]===undefined||b[k]===null||b[k]===''); if(missing.length) throw new Error('Missing required tenant fields: '+missing.join(', ')); const allowed=['whatsapp','email','web_chat','telegram','voice','internal']; if(!allowed.includes(b.channel)) throw new Error('Unsupported channel'); const input=b.input||{}; const customerKey=String(b.customer_id||input.customer_key||input.email||input.phone||'').trim(); if(!customerKey) throw new Error('customer_id or customer identifier required'); const message=String(input.message||input.text||'').trim(); if(!message) throw new Error('Support message is required'); return [{json:{organization_id:String(b.organization_id),agent_id:String(b.agent_id),conversation_id:b.conversation_id||null,customer_id:b.customer_id||null,customer_key:customerKey,idempotency_key:String(b.idempotency_key),channel:b.channel,event_type:b.event_type||'support.message_received',external_thread_key:b.external_thread_key||input.external_thread_key||null,input:{...input,message},received_at:new Date().toISOString(),workflow_key:'customer_support_v2'}}];

const env=$('Validate Support Envelope').first().json; const rows=Array.isArray($json)?$json:[$json]; const snap=rows[0]; if(!snap) throw new Error('Runtime snapshot not found'); const schema={category:'billing|technical|account|product|complaint|refund|general|other',priority:'low|normal|high|urgent',sentiment:'positive|neutral|frustrated|angry',resolution_status:'resolved|needs_information|action_required|human_required',confidence:'0-1 number',issue_summary:'string',reply:'string',missing_information:['string'],recommended_actions:[{type:'create_task|handoff|approval|none',title:'string',description:'string',risk_level:'low|medium|high'}],handoff_required:'boolean',handoff_reason:'string|null',follow_up_required:'boolean',follow_up_hours:'integer|null',conversation_status:'open|diagnosing|waiting_approval|resolved',memory_facts:[{type:'preference|fact|issue|resolution',summary:'string',confidence:'0-1'}]}; return [{json:{...env,execution_id:$('Queue Support Execution').first().json.execution_id,snapshot:snap,provider_request:{execution_id:$('Queue Support Execution').first().json.execution_id,organization_id:env.organization_id,agent_id:env.agent_id,instructions:snap.compiled_prompt+'\nUse only the supplied tenant knowledge and conversation context. Never invent policies, prices, account status or completed actions. Return strict JSON only using this schema: '+JSON.stringify(schema),input:JSON.stringify({message:env.input.message,customer:env.input.customer||{},support_context:env.input.support_context||{},channel:env.channel})}}}];

const ctx=$('Build Support Request').first().json; let raw=$json.output_text||$json.text||$json.response_text; if(!raw&&Array.isArray($json.output)) raw=$json.output.flatMap(x=>x.content||[]).map(x=>x.text||x.output_text||'').join(''); raw=String(raw||'').replace(/^```json\s*/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); let s; try{s=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){throw new Error('Invalid support AI JSON: '+raw.slice(0,300))} const categories=['billing','technical','account','product','complaint','refund','general','other']; const priorities=['low','normal','high','urgent']; const sentiments=['positive','neutral','frustrated','angry']; const resolutions=['resolved','needs_information','action_required','human_required']; const statuses=['open','diagnosing','waiting_approval','resolved']; s.category=categories.includes(s.category)?s.category:'other'; s.priority=priorities.includes(s.priority)?s.priority:'normal'; s.sentiment=sentiments.includes(s.sentiment)?s.sentiment:'neutral'; s.resolution_status=resolutions.includes(s.resolution_status)?s.resolution_status:'needs_information'; s.conversation_status=statuses.includes(s.conversation_status)?s.conversation_status:'open'; s.confidence=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(s.confidence)||0)); s.handoff_required=Boolean(s.handoff_required||s.resolution_status==='human_required'||s.priority==='urgent'); s.follow_up_required=Boolean(s.follow_up_required); s.follow_up_hours=s.follow_up_required?Math.max(1,Math.min(720,Math.round(Number(s.follow_up_hours)||24))):null; s.missing_information=Array.isArray(s.missing_information)?s.missing_information:[]; s.recommended_actions=Array.isArray(s.recommended_actions)?s.recommended_actions:[]; s.memory_facts=Array.isArray(s.memory_facts)?s.memory_facts:[]; return [{json:{...ctx,support:s,provider_usage:$json.usage||{},provider_response_id:$json.id||null}}];

const r=$json; const actions=[]; if(r.handoff_required) actions.push({type:'handoff',payload:r.handoff}); if(r.follow_up_required) actions.push({type:'follow_up',payload:r.follow_up}); for(const a of (r.approval_actions||[])) actions.push({type:'approval',payload:a}); if(r.reply_action) actions.push({type:'reply',payload:r.reply_action}); return [{json:{...r,actions}}];
